flora: Magnolia flower (large, cup-shaped, cream-colored petals, spirally arranged carpels)
Magnolia fruit (cone-like aggregate of follicles, showing bright red seeds)
Magnolia sapling (sturdy, upright with large, leathery oval leaves)
Bark detail (smooth and grey on young trees, becoming slightly plated/scaly with age)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'velvety' texture of the petals and the glossy sheen of the leaves; clear quadrant separation for educational study.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A large, open cream-colored flower; Top-Right: The distinctive red-seeded cone-fruit; Bottom-Left: A young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the smooth-to-plated grey bark.
visual_logic.ground: Rich organic dark brown soil with a few fallen cream petals.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to highlight the soft textures of the bloom.
